scene.kind: fixed-base planar parallelogram in XZ plane; four boxes and four revolute Y hinges
scene.inertia: diagonal cuboid mass formula m*(b^2+c^2)/12, explicit mass/inertia with lock_inertia=True
scene.articulation: world_fixed_base plus first three revolute joints form spanning tree; loop hinge remains outside articulation
scene.actuation: base_right EFFORT; all other revolute joints NONE; no limits, armature, friction or PD
scene.collision: none: no contact generation, all shapes noncolliding; shape geometry only for replay

cases.question: Does public reset FromActuatorQ recover passive joints and body poses on a closed loop rather than accepting arbitrary passive coordinates?
cases.procedure: At each target, public SolverKamino.reset with body_poses=FromActuatorQ(one angle) and body_velocities=ToDefault; save resulting body_q/body_qd/joint_q/joint_qd and success_mask. Use preceding output as continuation state. Each variant starts from same default state in a fresh process.
cases.reference: Analytic parallelogram: L=0.112; side centers +/-0.056 + 0.056*sin(theta), z=0.005+0.056*cos(theta), side rotations R_y(theta); top center x=0.112*sin(theta), z=0.005+0.112*cos(theta), top rotation identity. Base unchanged. Relative hinge angles [theta,-theta,theta,-theta].
metrics: max analytic body position error m
max analytic body rotation error rad
max body speed after zero-velocity reset
cases.threshold_basis: Float32 pose geometry and FK tolerance 1e-6; 10x geometric allowance for independent reconstruction and 1e-4 rad is below 0.006 degree. Both variants must meet the same fixed physical gates. Iteration/time differences are descriptive, not acceptance targets.

cases.question: Does the loop-closing constraint retain closure during nontrivial motion, compared with the same bodies/spanning tree without the closing hinge?
cases.initial_state: All four body transforms as scene definition, all velocities zero; no FK needed for the initially consistent geometry
cases.procedure: Reset to default, clear forces each step, apply constant active-joint torque, step and swap states. Save t=0 and every output step. No collision calls. Compute virtual missing hinge anchors in A identically to the real hinge in B.
metrics: solver status and physical residuals if exposed
step elapsed time after warmup (descriptive only)
cases.threshold_basis: 0.5mm is below 0.5% of 112mm hinge spacing, and 1mm/5x negative-control gates establish that measuring the closure edge matters. If the separation does not occur, retain runs as inconclusive rather than altering thresholds. Structural intervention, not single-parameter A/B.

failure_policy: Never overwrite failed runs or broaden thresholds after observing results. API/harness fixes require a versioned runner record and a documented reason; physical protocol changes require a new frozen protocol revision before subsequent runs.
scope_limitations: one fixed-base four-bar, one active hinge, planar branch near initial pose
no contacts, joint limits, motors, multiworld, GPU, singular toggle configurations or underactuated FK
no claim of general loop solvability, global branch selection, long-time stability or backend performance
reviewed_by: root agent: static source and physical reference review before any runtime
